language.title: Language:
language.body: In Settings (after Theme), choose a language source (locale - name). Yomikiru ships English; you can Install pack... a community .zip (one locale per pack), Export... a pack to share, or remove an installed pack. Missing strings in a pack fall back to English.

defaultLocation: Set <link>Default Location</link> in Settings (Library section) to the folder where you usually store manga and books.

fileArrangement.title: Recommended File Arrangement:
fileArrangement.body: Though you can open manga from anywhere, it is recommended to arrange file in way as shown below for better experience and features like "reader side-list".

dragDrop.title: Drag and Drop support.
dragDrop.folder: Dropping a folder will open the reader with that folders content.
dragDrop.image: Dropping a supported image file will open its parent folder in the reader
dragDrop.archive: Dropping archive or epub file will open them in the reader

searchShortcuts.title: Search bar shortcut keys :
searchShortcuts.navigate: With any search bar focused click {{down}} or {{up}} to navigate through results.
searchShortcuts.selectSingle: Click {{select}} (without item focused) if only one item in list to open.
searchShortcuts.selectEmpty: Click {{select}} on empty folder to open in reader.
searchShortcuts.dirUp: Click {{up}} to go up a directory/folder. In gallery details, the same shortcut returns to the cover grid and focuses search, including after closing the reader back to that page. It does not run while Settings or AniList overlays are open, or while typing in a field.
searchShortcuts.contextMenu: Click {{menu}} buttons to get right click menu of focused item (classic lists, gallery tiles, and details rows).
searchShortcuts.focusPageSearch: {{focus}} focuses the main search field on the current page (classic Continue Reading / History when that list is shown, otherwise Bookmarks then Locations; gallery toolbar, or the open details list; manga sidelist or book find-in-page; AniList search; and the Settings search field while Settings is open). Does not run while typing in an input.
searchShortcuts.settingsJump: While Settings is open, type in the search field at the top to jump to a setting, shortcut, About, or Usage section. Selecting a result moves focus to that control. {{focus}} focuses the search field. Escape clears the query, then closes Settings.
searchShortcuts.byType: Search by type: Type manga|manhua|manhwa|webtoon|webcomic|comic to search for manga/manhua/manhwa/webtoon/webcomic/comic or epub for epub.

homeLocation.title: Home Location tab :
homeLocation.clickItem: In location tab, click item to see its content or double-click (if enabled in settings above) to open it in reader.

openDirectly.link: Open chapter in reader directly if chapter is a sub-folder of sub-folder of "Default Location".
openDirectly.example: Example: If the default location is set to {{path}} and there is a folder named One Piece within it, any sub-folder located directly under One Piece will open automatically by clicking its link in the home location list. If no images are found then the sub-folder will be opened in location tab normally.

search.title: Search:
search.symlink: Symbolic links (symlinks) to directories are treated as directories in Locations/Home Location, so you can browse and open content through linked folders.
search.partial: You don't need to type the whole word in search. (e.g. For One Piece type op).
search.exact: For exact search, add " or ` in front of search. (e.g. For One Piece type `one).
search.paste: Paste link to set browse pasted link in Locations tab. Or page link of a supported file to open it in reader directly.
search.dDrive: Type let D:\ to go to D drive.
search.openInSearch: Type name ending with {{sep}} to open it in search. e.g. When there is a directory named One piece in current list, type One Piece{{sep}} to open that as new list.

collapseTabs: Collapse/Un-collapse Bookmarks, History page tabs by clicking on the Dividers beside them in home screen.

gallery.title: Gallery:
gallery.body: Click a book to open its details page (bookmarks and notes from the reader; click an entry to open the book at that place). Click manga for chapters and bookmarks as before (empty image folders are hidden from the chapter list). Right-click a tile for <bold>Continue Reading</bold>, <bold>Show in File Explorer</bold>, copy path, <bold>Add to Favourites</bold> / <bold>Remove from Favourites</bold>, <bold>Remove from Library</bold> (files on disk stay), and (with AniList connected) <bold>Track with AniList</bold>. In details, back is on the cover; list tabs match the gallery toolbar (no counts on the tabs); manga chapters-read is shown as read/total; click the title note to edit it, then <bold>Esc</bold> or click away to save. Copy Path briefly shows Copied. The header starts at a rem-sized auto height and scrolls if the metadata is taller; drag the divider to resize (the cover scales with the visible height; can go shorter than that auto size; remembered for manga and books). On manga Content, <bold>Locate current chapter</bold> scrolls to the last-read chapter. Hero buttons include favourite, edit metadata, <bold>Show in File Explorer</bold>, and <bold>Copy Path</bold>. About and genres appear when a tracker or your edits supply them. <bold>Edit tags</bold> assigns labels you create (not free-form). Directory Up returns to the grid and focuses search (including after closing the reader back to details). Right-click the cover for the same library path actions; use the compact AniList control next to Continue when logged in. If the library folder or EPUB is missing on disk, a highlighted error banner above the header shows <bold>Locate on disk</bold> (re-link the path; warns if the name does not match) or <bold>Remove from Library</bold> while cover, bookmarks, and notes stay visible. Classic History / Bookmark and Continue Reading use the same dialog when the library root is missing. For manga only: if the series folder is still there but the last-opened chapter is gone, choose <bold>Open first chapter</bold> or <bold>Locate chapter</bold> (pick the renamed/moved chapter folder/archive); bookmarks can still be removed. This does not apply to EPUB.

galleryToolbar.title: Gallery toolbar:
galleryToolbar.body: One bar above the grid with section tabs (<bold>Continue</bold> / <bold>Library</bold> / <bold>Bookmarks</bold> / <bold>Favourites</bold>), a type filter (<bold>All</bold> / <bold>Manga/Webcomic</bold> / <bold>eBook</bold>), a tag filter when you have created tags (<bold>All tags</bold> or one tag), then sort (every section except Continue), view mode (Cover + Title / Cover Only / Compact / List), and a grid-size control, with search on the right of those actions.
galleryToolbar.types: <bold>Manga/Webcomic</bold> covers every image-based series (manga, manhwa, manhua, comics, webtoons); <bold>eBook</bold> covers EPUB files only, not PDF. Hover a segment for the full list. The choice is remembered and applies to all sections.
galleryToolbar.tags: Create tags from a title's details page (<bold>Edit tags</bold>). Assign as many as you like from that list (names are unique ignoring case). The toolbar tag filter is a compact list: choose one tag, combined with the type filter. It is not remembered after you leave Gallery.
galleryToolbar.continue: <bold>Continue Reading</bold> shows items with progress, always newest last-read first. There is no sort control on this tab.
galleryToolbar.library: <bold>Library</bold> shows everything; sort by title, date, or last read in either direction.
galleryToolbar.bookmarks: <bold>Bookmarks</bold> shows titles that have at least one bookmark. Search and sort match Library (title, date, or last read). Opening a tile shows the Bookmarks list in the details panel; play still continues last progress.
galleryToolbar.favourites: <bold>Favourites</bold> lists titles you have starred from a tile's context menu, the details header, or bulk Add to Favourites. Search and sort match Library. Removing more than one favourite from the selection menu asks first.
galleryToolbar.clear: Search fields across the app show a small <bold>x</bold> button while they contain text; click it to clear the filter.

multiSelect.title: Multi-select:
multiSelect.body: Tick the checkbox on a gallery tile, chapter, bookmark, or note to enter selection mode. Hold Shift and click another item to select the range between them. The toolbar swaps to show Select All, Invert Selection (gallery / details), a 3-dot menu with bulk actions (e.g. Copy Path, Bookmark, Add to Favourites / Remove from Favourites, Remove Bookmark, Remove from Library, Mark as Read/Unread, Delete Notes), and a cancel button. Removing more than one favourite asks first. Copy Path on a remaining control briefly shows Copied. In gallery / details, use Ctrl+A (or Cmd+A) to select all and Esc to clear — these shortcuts do not run while typing in a search field, and they are not used on classic home lists. Classic Bookmark / History checkboxes can be toggled under Other Settings (Classic List Checkboxes).

covers.title: Covers:
covers.body: Generated thumbnails are saved under user data covers as {{libraryId}}. The gallery uses that file when present. If you use Select Cover in the details panel, the app stores that image's absolute path on the library entry and shows it when the file still exists; otherwise it falls back to the cached WebP. Library in Settings (first section) holds Default Location, bulk import from that folder, and thumbnail clear/regenerate. Missing files and folders are skipped during regenerate and reported in one warning at the end. The UI is locked while folder import or recursive EPUB scan runs.

reader.title: Reader :
reader.verticalScroll: When using the "vertical Scroll" mode, you can change chapters on the first or last page by clicking on either side of the screen or by clicking "prevPage" ({{prev}}) or "nextPage" ({{next}}) shortcut keys. No response in center 20% of screen.
reader.maxWidth: Limit width of images in reader. To use "Max Image Width" feature, disable "Size:Clamp".
reader.mouseScroll: To scroll using mouse while viewing full page, use "Left to Right" or "Right to Left" reading mode, then "Fit Vertically" option or make image size lower than window height.
reader.middleMouse: Middle mouse button for auto scrolling.
reader.sideList: Access the side list by moving the mouse to left side of the screen. You can pin and resize the side list.
reader.sideListSearch: {{focus}} focuses the sidelist chapter search (same Focus search command as home). {{random}} opens a random chapter (avoids recently opened; works with shuffle mode).

shuffle.title: Shuffle mode
shuffle.body: (shuffle icon in sidelist): randomizes chapter order once; prev/next follow shuffled order. Auto-refresh disabled in this mode. Session-only.

sidelistSearch2.title: Sidelist search:
sidelistSearch2.body: When filter is active, prev/next and random use the filtered list. Use the pin icon next to the search input to persist the filter when the list refreshes (e.g. auto-refresh, manual Refresh).

reader.zenMode: Zen Mode (Full Screen Mode): Hides UI, Only shows images and page number if enabled. Can be enabled using the shortcut key defined, {{zen}}
reader.doubleClick: Double click to toggle zen mode. Working area by reading mode:

fileExplorer.intro: Open chapter directly from the file explorer after enabling <link>File Explorer Option</link>.
fileExplorer.rightClick: Right Click on folder or .cbz/.7z/.zip/.pdf/.epub   →   Show more options (win11)   →   Open in Yomikiru.
fileExplorer.note: Note that this only opens the chapter containing images, not the Manga Folder.

tray.title: Minimize to Tray:
tray.body: Enable in <link>Other Settings</link> to send the window to the system tray instead of the taskbar when minimizing. With one window, left-click the tray icon to show or hide it; with multiple windows, left-click restores hidden windows or focuses. Right-click for the window list, <bold>Hide all Windows</bold>, and Exit. Exit respects "Confirm Close Window" when enabled.

theme.body: <link>Copy theme using "Copy Current Theme to Clipboard" under theme</link>, it will be copied as text and you can share it anywhere. To install the theme, copy whole text you received and click on "Save Theme from Clipboard".

readerPresets.title: Reader Presets:
readerPresets.body: Quick-switch between reading setups (e.g. 2-page LTR manga vs vertical-scroll manhwa). Separate preset lists for manga and book (EPUB) readers.

defaults.title: Defaults:
defaults.body: Manga — Paged LTR, Long Strip, Long Strip with Gaps. Book — Default, Continuous. On first run, a "User" preset per type is created with your current settings.

readerPresets.select: <bold>Select</bold> applies a preset. <bold>Delete</bold> (trash icon) removes a custom preset; if the deleted preset was selected, another preset is auto-selected. The "User" preset cannot be removed.
readerPresets.reader: In Reader Settings: <bold>+</bold> adds a new preset (name via modal). <bold>Autosave</bold> toggle: when on, changes are saved into the selected preset automatically; off requires manual Update or <bold>savePreset</bold> shortcut. User preset has autosave on by default. <bold>Save</bold> (floppy icon) manually updates the selected preset.
readerPresets.savePreset: {{save}} saves current settings into the selected preset. Works even when the Reader Settings panel is closed; feedback shows the preset name.

keybinds.title: Preset keybinds:
keybinds.slots: select preset 1-5 by display order. Slot keys are shared: in manga reader they select manga presets, in EPUB reader they select book presets. Use up/down buttons to reorder presets.

clipboard.title: Clipboard:
clipboard.body: "Copy Current Preset to Clipboard" copies the selected preset (from each Manga/Book section). "Save Preset from Clipboard" (top, next to Reset) imports one preset; type is inferred from the JSON.

exportImport.title: Export/Import:
exportImport.body: Per manga or book. Export saves custom presets only (defaults excluded). Import from file for bulk transfer; duplicates by id are skipped.

reset.title: Reset to Default Presets
reset.body: restores built-in presets to their original state; if a "User" preset for manga or book is missing, it is recreated from your current reader settings. Custom presets are kept.

pdfScale.body: Set the quality of the images. Higher number means higher quality but also high initial cpu and storage usage.
pdfScale.warning: Do not use high scale with pdf which have high page count.

anilist.title: AniList Tracking :
anilist.login: After logging in you can add tracking from the reader side list, the gallery details page (compact AniList control), a gallery tile context menu, or the open manga side list.
anilist.managed: Tracking is stored in the library database per title and provider. Locate on disk keeps the tracker with the item; removing the library entry removes the tracker. Cached title metadata (About, genres, score) is stored locally and refreshed when you open or sync a tracked title. Your AniList login token stays in this app's local storage, not in the database backup.
anilist.autoUpdate: Enable <bold>Auto-update AniList progress</bold> in reader settings to increment the remote progress when you finish a manga chapter or advance in a book. You can still edit status, score, and counts from the AniList editor.

epubBackground.title: EPUB Reader Background:
epubBackground.body: While reading EPUB, open Reader Settings. In <bold>Styles & Others</bold>, <bold>Page background color</bold> is the canvas behind the column; <bold>Content background color</bold> is the text column. Expand <bold>Content frame</bold> for <bold>Padding inline</bold> and optional <bold>Content border</bold> (width, style, color). Expand the <bold>Background</bold> section for wallpaper.
epubBackground.wallpaper: Enable <bold>Background image (wallpaper)</bold>, select an image, then adjust dim intensity, brightness, and contrast.
epubBackground.overlay: Optionally enable <bold>Image layer overlay</bold> and set its color and opacity.
epubBackground.transparent: To make the text column transparent so the wallpaper shows through: set Content background color to transparent (e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0)).
epubBackground.override: Some books ship strong text or background colors in their own CSS. Enable <bold>Override EPUB colors (when customized)</bold> so your non-default font, link, page, and content background colors win over the book's styles (same section as those options).

about.body: In <link><bold>About</bold></link>, use <bold>Detailed Info</bold> to view version, commit, build date, Electron/Node versions, and OS details. Use <bold>Copy</bold> to paste this info when reporting issues.

customStylesheet.body: If you know how to write .css, you can customize style of app, more than just theme color that is enabled by "Theme Maker", by making your custom .css file and adding it as Custom Stylesheet. You can use developer/inspect tool to check the element and existing styles.
customStylesheet.note: NOTE: Do not move " .css " file in directly under app's folder. If you are using portable version, everything except userdata folder will be deleted. You can safely put it inside userdata folder.

dbBackup.title: Library Database Backup:
dbBackup.body: In Settings, enable automatic backups of the library database (bookmarks, history, reading progress). Choose how often (hours), how many newest files to keep, use Backup Now, Show backups to restore a snapshot or Show in File Explorer to highlight it, or Import & Restore a .db file from anywhere. Files live under the app data backups folder. Restore restarts the app and replaces data.db.
